import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[6];
        if (n > 0) a[0] = sc.nextInt();
        if (n > 1) a[1] = sc.nextInt();
        if (n > 2) a[2] = sc.nextInt();
        if (n > 3) a[3] = sc.nextInt();
        if (n == 5) a[4] = sc.nextInt();

        // Bubble sort
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n - i - 1; ++j) {
                if (a[j] > a[j + 1]) {
                    int temp = a[j];
                    a[j] = a[j + 1];
                    a[j + 1] = temp;
                }
            }
        }

        int t = (a[0] + a[n - 1]) >> 1;
        int left_idx = -1, right_idx = n;
        while (++left_idx < n && a[left_idx] <= t);
        while (--right_idx >= 0 && a[right_idx] >= t);
        int left_candidate;
        if (left_idx > 0 && Math.abs(a[left_idx - 1] - t) < Math.abs(a[left_idx] - t)) {
            left_candidate = a[left_idx - 1];
        } else {
            left_candidate = a[left_idx];
        }

        int right_candidate;
        if (right_idx >= 0 && Math.abs(a[right_idx] - t) < Math.abs(a[right_idx + 1] - t)) {
            right_candidate = a[right_idx];
        } else {
            right_candidate = a[right_idx + 1];
        }

        int result = (Math.abs(a[left_idx] - t) < Math.abs(a[right_idx] - t)) ? left_candidate : right_candidate;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
